title: ebay | How To | Shop with eBay ShopBot
description: Meet eBay ShopBot! Your own personal shopping assistant right in Facebook Messenger. It's simple to customize your shopping experience with eBay ShopBot. You can send eBay ShopBot a pic and it will find similar items and it remembers what you like and what fits you from your size profile to your favorite electronics! Try it here: http://ebay.to/2nTeNgi eBay YouTube Customer Support Hours are Monday – Friday, 6:00AM – 6:00PM PST. For help outside these hours, please contact eBay Customer Service at http://ebay.to/2iXYNIC

asr.full_text: Hi my name's Kendra and I'm part of the eBay customer service team. Today I'm here to tell you about a new, completely different way to shop called the eBay ShopBot. eBay ShopBot is a personal shopping assistant right in Facebook Messenger, and it finds you the best deals and coolest items quickly and easily. Powered by artificial intelligence, eBay ShopBot learns what you like, and provides the best options for you while you shop. you a more personal streamlined shopping experience every time to start using eBay shop bot first you'll need to download the Facebook messenger app if you don't already have it once you download it and signed into facebook Messenger you're ready to start shopping in the search field type in eBay Shop bot and select it press get started and you're ready to go to start shopping just send eBay shop shop bot and select it. Press get started and you're ready to go. To start shopping, just send eBay Shop bot a message and tell it what you're looking for. eBay shop bot has natural language understanding built into it, which allows it to easily understand the way that you speak rather than traditional search terms. You can ask for something specific or a broader description and it'll help you narrow it down to the perfect item. You can also send it other factors, like colors and sizes, to your budget. Try texting something like, I'd like Nike running shoes for under $100. eBay Shopbot is learning and growing with you along the way with each shopping journey. Right now, it is still in beta, and is stronger at shopping and certain departments more than others. But the more you use eBay Shopbot, the better and expert it will be in a variety of different areas. One of eBay ShopBot's most unique features is image shopping. See an item you like in a store, on TV, Instagram or just walking in the street? Snap a photo and send it to eBay ShopBot and it will come back with similar items. eBay ShopBot helps narrow down the options by asking clarifying questions such as color, size, or brand. Select from quick option buttons or type your own answer at any time. It's even learning to remember what you've already told it, and which questions make more sense to ask and when. eBay ShopBot also helps you get the right item for you with smart personal guidance. So, instead of just showing you a list of items, it will show you the items that are the best deals out there the trendiest items or just the closest to what you want it'll even let you know if there's a better option. This is done to save you time and to allow ebay shopbots do the research work for you searching for the best prices comparing quality and watching trends to save even more time type size profile and quickly mark your size preferences. eBay ShopBot will then show you fashion items that fit your size. It also has great collections that change based on the time of year, seasonal trends, or different events and it gets even better around the holidays. When you're trying to find the perfect presence eBay Shopbot has gift guides for every kind of person in your life. Once you've found an item you like select View item to see that exact one or choose more like this to see similar options. Once you've found the item you're looking for select buy. If you've already signed in it'll take you directly to the checkout page to complete your purchase.Select confirm and pay and from here you'll see an order confirmation as well as receive a confirmation email. And there you have it! A quicker, easier way to shop just by chatting in your Facebook Messenger. The more you use eBay ShopBot the more it truely becomes your personal shopping assistant. eBay ShopBot is getting better every day with more features and smarts in the works. So please leave us feedback and help influence how it grows! We hope you're as excited about eBay ShopBot as we are. Search for eBay ShopBot in your Facebook Messenger or click the link in the description below the video and start utilizing your personal shopping assistant today.
